dz: 在君士坦丁堡，圣索菲亚大教堂的圆顶在建成二十年后倒塌。查士丁尼一世立即下令重建圆顶。
de: In Constantinople, the dome of the Hagia Sophia collapses, twenty years after its construction. Justinian I immediately orders that the dome be rebuilt.

t: 克洛塔尔一世被封为法兰克人之王.
te: Chlothar I is crowned King of the Franks.
dz: 克洛塔尔一世被封为法兰克人之王.
de: Chlothar I is crowned King of the Franks.
